title: The first steps are done
author: n3wdl
selftext:
I know the graphics need to improve but yesterday i did the first „Mini-Live-Test“ and i played my own mmo prototype with my buddy.

we tested my turn based combat system and gathered some ressources to craft heal potions xd it aint much but i was so happy to achieve that small milestone. 

There is still a lot to do
